From the two piercing equations:
\[
S+16(r-14c)=S+24(r-15c)
\]
\[
16r-224c=24r-360c \implies r=17c
\]
So the stone’s daily growth equals 17 warriors’ daily consumption.

To ensure the sky is never pierced, the net growth rate must be nonpositive:
\[
r-nc \le 0 \implies n \ge \frac{r}{c}=17
\]

Thus at least \(17\) plant warriors are needed.

\[
\boxed{17}
\]
